1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the charge sheet No. 553 of 2018 dated 27.08.2018 as well as entire proceedings of Case Crime No. 378 of 2018, under Sections- 498-A, 323, 494, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act against applicant No. 1 and under Section 498A,
323, 504, 506 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act against applicant Nos. 2, 3 & 4 and under Section 494 I.P.C.
against applicant No. 5, Police Station- Lisari, District- Meerut, pending in the court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 6, Meerut.

sentences.text:
The case was heard on 13.07.2023 and the Court has passed the following order:-
"Heard learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.

Learned counsel for the applicants submitted that parties have entered into compromise on 24.05.2023 and the same has been filed before the trial Court, but till date no verification report has been sent by the tiral Court, therefore direction may be issued to trial Court to send the verification report to this Court.
Under such facts of the case, Special C.J.M., Meerut is directed to verify the compromise dated 24.05.2023 and submit verification report maximum within six weeks.
List this case on 17.08.2023.
Till then no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants.

Registrar(Compliance) is directed to send a copy of this order within 48 hours to Special C.J.M., Meerut for strict compliance."
4.

Pursuant to order dated 13.07.2023, compromise has been verified by Special C.J.M., Meerut vide order dated 16.08.2023 and the same has been received to this Court from Special C.J.M., Meerut vide letter dated 16.08.2023.

5. Learned counsel for the applicants informed that in terms of interim settlement before the Mediation Centre on 26.02.2021, Rs. 2,00,000/- has been deposited by the applicant No. 1 with Mediation Centre, which is still pending at there and now, in terms of compromise entered between the parties, the aforesaid amount of Rs. 2,00,000/- has to be returned to applicant No. 1.
6.
Learned counsel for the opposite party No. 2 has not objected the aforesaid facts and submitted that in case proceedings against the applicants is quashed, he would have no objection.
7. In view of the facts and circumstances of the case, the applicants and opposite party no. 2 do not want to pursue the case any further as stated by them.
The matter has been mutually settled between the parties, therefore, no useful purpose would be served in proceeding with the matter further.

8. Thus in view of the well settled principle of law as laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the matters of Krishnappa & Ors. vs. State of Karnataka; 2021 0 Supreme(SC) 529, Parbatbhai Aahir @
Parbatbhai Bhimsinhbhai Karmur and Ors. vs. State of Gujarat and another; 2017 9 SCC 641, B.S.
Joshi Vs. State of Haryana; 2003(4) SCC 675, Nikhil Merchant Vs. Central Burea of Investigation and another; (2008) 9 Supreme Court Cases 677, Gian Singh Vs. Stated of Punjab; (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & others Vs. State of Punjab and another; (2014) Supreme Today 642, the proceedings of the aforesaid case is hereby quashed.
